offence_category.reason: Conviction is for murder under Section 302 read with 34.

final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeal, so conviction stands.

offence_finally_established.reason: Court held the case falls under Section 302, not Exception 4.

imprisonment_type.reason: Sentence was life imprisonment, not a fixed term.

imprisonment_years.quote: sentencing them to suffer life imprisonment
imprisonment_years.reason: No fixed term of 20 years appears; sentence is life imprisonment.

fine_rs.reason: Fine of Rs. 1000/- each is stated.
